welcome.headline: Precision Case Management for High Court Advocates
welcome.description: Manage your assigned dockets, daily cause lists, hearing calendars, live court tokens, and confidential preparation notes in an isolated, role-protected workspace.
welcome.pillar1Desc: Each advocate accesses only their assigned cases, private notes, and voice memos.
welcome.pillar2Desc: Track hearings across Day, Week, and Month views with automated reminders.
welcome.pillar3Desc: Dedicated admin oversight for advocate onboarding and case assignments.
welcome.footerDisclaimer: APHC Case Tracker is an independent legal productivity application and is not an official portal of the High Court of Andhra Pradesh or the Government.
